name: GarageFlow - Business - ${ENVIRONMENT}
description: Daily work orders (OS): seven America/Sao_Paulo business dates, including partial today. Database snapshots refresh every 5 minutes. The 15-minute query window selects recent telemetry, not the business reporting period. Missing telemetry is not zero activity. Validate received values against persisted work orders after deployment.

pages.name: Work orders - seven business days (today partial)
pages.description: Created volume uses CreatedAt; eligible completion count and mean use CompletedAt. Elapsed completion = CompletedAt - StartedAt, once per OS in Completed or Delivered with valid timestamps. No eligible OS means a null/absent mean; equal timestamps give a real zero. Diagnosis, approval wait, pickup wait, integration failures and uptime are separate indicators. Check snapshot freshness before interpreting values.

widgets.title: OS created by creation date - Sao Paulo (today partial)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(garageflow.work_orders.created) AS 'Created OS' WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' AND work_orders.timezone = 'America/Sao_Paulo' FACET work_orders.date ORDER BY max(garageflow.work_orders.snapshot.timestamp) LIMIT 7 SINCE 15 minutes ago

widgets.title: Mean elapsed completion (minutes) by completion date - today partial

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT if(latest(garageflow.work_orders.completed) > 0, latest(garageflow.work_orders.duration.mean) / 60) AS 'Mean minutes (null without eligible OS)' WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' AND work_orders.timezone = 'America/Sao_Paulo' FACET work_orders.date ORDER BY max(garageflow.work_orders.snapshot.timestamp) LIMIT 7 SINCE 15 minutes ago

widgets.title: Eligible completed OS by completion date - Sao Paulo (today partial)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(garageflow.work_orders.completed) AS 'Eligible completed OS' WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' AND work_orders.timezone = 'America/Sao_Paulo' FACET work_orders.date ORDER BY max(garageflow.work_orders.snapshot.timestamp) LIMIT 7 SINCE 15 minutes ago

widgets.title: Daily snapshot freshness - Sao Paulo local time; refresh every 5 minutes

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(garageflow.work_orders.created) AS 'Created OS', latest(garageflow.work_orders.completed) AS 'Eligible completed OS', if(latest(garageflow.work_orders.completed) > 0, latest(garageflow.work_orders.duration.mean) / 60) AS 'Mean minutes (null without eligible OS)', toDatetime(latest(garageflow.work_orders.snapshot.timestamp) * 1000, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', timezone: 'America/Sao_Paulo') AS 'Successful refresh started (Sao Paulo)' WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' AND work_orders.timezone = 'America/Sao_Paulo' FACET work_orders.date ORDER BY max(garageflow.work_orders.snapshot.timestamp) LIMIT 7 SINCE 15 minutes ago
